scenarios: an operator-installed, signed skill with a PROMOTE evaluation of its exact content: 30 train runs with it verify (a provider that succeeds only when the skill's instructions reach it) and 3 without it fail; a signed but unevaluated skill runs qualified=false and is left out: 33 samples, fixer@<hash> 30/30, none 0/3 low-confidence; 30 holdout runs with the skill

a routed request with the skill compiles FEASIBLE and pins fixer@<hash> in plan provenance; without it QUALITY_FLOOR_INFEASIBLE with none; the Policy Lab finds the combination FEASIBLE and confirmed on the untouched holdout, the bare model NO_FEASIBLE_CONFIGURATION

EPR-FI-013: a repository's own signed skill with a PROMOTE evaluation beside it is qualified=false (no self-promotion); a changed skill pins a new set and is infeasible (stale statistics rejected); a revoked pack is SKILL_REVOKED with the lease operations of a control task; in an isolated replay a skill asking for git.commit/git.push is SKILL_EXCEEDS_REVIEWER_CEILING while one within fs.read/fs.write is selected
audit: SCAFFOLDED: StatKey::Solver had a skill field but samples and the compiler hard-coded none; provenance pinned no skill; harness ignored context configuration; no qualification distinction, no revocation; repository skills could be self-evaluated; reviewer skills beyond the ceiling were trimmed, not refused.
proof: Real Core, signed registry and skills, 69 real runs as train and holdout statistics, the Policy Lab, an isolated sandboxed replay.
negative_proof: Seven mutations each fail the qualification: the compiler ignoring the skill set, unqualified outcomes pooled, workspace skills qualifying, revocation ignored, the reviewer ceiling off, the plan not pinning the set, the set without content hashes.
limitations: No run chooses an effort yet (model configuration is the bare model); the context tier enters through the harness version only; the escalation key does not carry the skill set; qualification reads the operator's evaluation record; no threshold profile is owner-approved.
